text: Kenya has recorded its first death in the 2026 Ebola outbreak, triggering an urgent containment response. The outbreak has so far been centred on the DRC, which reported 8,700+ cases and 4,200+ deaths as of Oct 11.

judge.comment: Significant spread beyond DRC, figures match tracker events and KPIs.

factChecks.claim: Kenya recorded its first Ebola death (Oct 12)
DRC 8,700+ cases and 4,200+ deaths as of Oct 11

text: Kenia registró su primera muerte en el brote de ébola de 2026, lo que activó una respuesta urgente de contención. La RDC reportaba más de 8,700 casos y más de 4,200 muertes al 11 de octubre.

judge.comment: Spanish version of the Kenya breaking tweet; same verified figures.

factChecks.claim: Kenya recorded its first Ebola death (Oct 12)
DRC 8,700+ cases and 4,200+ deaths as of Oct 11

text: Iran's IRGC Navy reports an oil tanker struck a mine in the Strait of Hormuz (Oct 12). Independent confirmation pending. It adds mine warfare to a crisis in which at least 11 commercial ships have been attacked since early October.

judge.comment: Claim is attributed to the IRGC Navy; context figure from the Oct 10 event.

factChecks.claim: IRGC Navy reports tanker struck a mine in Hormuz
At least 11 commercial ships attacked since early October

text: Putin offers a single-day ceasefire to let Ukraine hold elections, rejecting Zelensky's proposal of elections in exchange for a 60-day ceasefire (Oct 11-12). The two positions are now a day versus 60 days apart.

judge.comment: Both positions drawn directly from tracker events.

factChecks.claim: Putin offers single-day ceasefire for Ukraine elections
Zelensky offered elections for a 60-day ceasefire

text: A second Houthi strike on Riyadh airport killed 1 and injured 11 on Oct 12; Dammam airport was also targeted. The earlier Riyadh strike toll was revised on Oct 11 to 12 killed and 300+ injured. Saudi Arabia has further suspended airport flights.

judge.comment: Figures come from event titles only; a human should confirm details before posting.

factChecks.claim: Second strike on Riyadh airport kills 1, injures 11; Dammam also targeted
Earlier toll revised to 12 killed, 300+ injured
Saudi Arabia further suspends airport flights

text: How many families has the Sinaloa cartel war displaced? Universidad Autónoma de Sinaloa documented at least 9,000 families (early 2025). The state government acknowledges 1,763 families in official shelters. Two counts, a five-fold gap.

judge.comment: Both figures are in the tracker's disputed list; the UAS count is dated early 2025 and the counting bases may differ. Contested type requires human review.

factChecks.claim: UAS documented at least 9,000 families displaced (early 2025)
factChecks.source: Sinaloa disputes: Universidad Autónoma de Sinaloa

factChecks.claim: State government acknowledges 1,763 families in official shelters
